title: Mike Vrabel explains his comments about lack of depth on roster

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Vrabel explains his comments about lack of depth on roster
sources.description: After New England's Week 2 preseason game, Patriots coach Mike Vrabel explained that he hasn't been playing key starters in the preseason because "I do not think we have a very deep team."
